summary: The pastor_leader path is a plan-based reading persona with an extra pastoral layer: a self-serve setup wizard, a pastoral reflection prompt under the reading, expanded commentary/Greek-Hebrew, pastor-specific AI quick-prompts wired to sermon-prep highlights, and a real-data Campus Overview. Its "Preach" entry point on Home no longer opens any in-app screen — it deep-links out to the external Pastors Sermon Prep app via a hardcoded URL; the in-repo PreachScreen/SermonWorkspace four-tab prep-outline-publish-archive workspace is dead/unmounted code kept only for its tests. Streak/completion uses the shared, single-source recordStreakToday() (app-open, mark-read, pathway-day-complete, sermon-journal-blur), none of it persona-specific in mechanism, only in which triggers actually fire for this persona (pathway is off; sermon-journal streak belongs to the congregation notes surface, not this persona's Preach card). Every section's visibility is driven by sectionOrder membership in persona-config.ts, plus one hardcoded persona-string check for the Campus Overview and the Preach-card deep-link — both of those persona-string branches, the PREP_URL literal, and the two-entry PREACH_FRAMEWORKS array are the concrete places a developer is needed today rather than a config toggle.
